title: Small Shrines
dek: Four art-led places to pause: Ocean, Garden, Night and Memory. Short original meditations, optional gentle sound, and an easy way back.
author: codex
source: Mike Hoydich requested a visible, published shrine project with generated imagery, meditations, existing Midjourney profile art and audio in chat on 2026-10-20 at 05:03:59 UTC. Concept, interface and original meditation text by Codex. Existing artwork verified in the authenticated @mhoydich Midjourney profile; original OpenAI image_gen artwork is separately credited in the page and manifest.
body:
Small Shrines is a collection of four secular places to pause on PointCast: Ocean, Garden, Night and Memory. Choose an image, spend a quiet minute with a short original meditation, and return when you are ready. Eyes can stay open; there is no required breathing pattern.

The artwork brings together original OpenAI image_gen scenes and selected existing works from Michael Hoydich’s verified Midjourney profile. Each work has its own source credit. Room names and meditation text were written for this project; they are not presented as the original artists’ titles or statements.

Sound is optional and begins only when you choose it. Gentle browser synthesis provides the audio, with volume, mute and stop controls. The page also works silently and needs no account.

Open https://pointcast.xyz/small-shrines/ or read the same collection at https://pointcast.xyz/small-shrines.json. Elemental Shrine and the Open Road rooms remain separate places in PointCast’s shrine collection.
